scope: Art production. No new gameplay build or deployment.

keys.pose: neutral low-ready, supported three-quarter right view

families.name: Idle and ready
families.motion: Neutral, subtle breathing, weight load, combat-ready settle

families.name: Low cover brace and contact
families.motion: Body drop, shoulder/forearm contact, pelvis/knee compression, equipment settle

families.name: Right corner peek and weapon raise
families.motion: Edge stop, head check, ribcage lean, shoulder/elbow/wrist clearance, stock/cheek alignment, muzzle clear

families.name: Fire, recoil and retract
families.motion: Aim hold, discharge pose, weapon kick, arm/shoulder absorption, recovery, deliberate tuck to brace

families.name: Left corner and over-cover views
families.motion: Side-correct left peek; top rise, planted hands as applicable, center/left/right aim, tuck; no mirroring shortcuts

families.name: Locomotion and pivots
families.motion: Start/load, acceleration, two-step run cycle, brake plant, compression, stop, turn/pivot and recovery

families.name: Baseball/spacewalk slide
families.motion: Run plant, pelvis drop, lead leg extension, trailing leg tuck, travel, brake, kneeling recovery and return

families.name: Slide into cover
families.motion: Approach, anticipatory tuck, contact, impact compression, hair/coat/cable overshoot, low attached settle

families.name: Cover shimmy and reversal
families.motion: Left/right load, inside foot plant, pelvis travel, outside foot catch, brake, reversal and hard edge stop

families.name: Corner wrap and exits
families.motion: Planted pivot, coordinated foot/hip/shoulder turn around both sides, reattach, kick-away, detach and move; vault only with separate mechanic validation

families.name: Independent aim and weapon handling
families.motion: Strafe, backpedal, lower-body reposition with agreed aim limits; shotgun first, then pistol/AR/sniper grip, recoil and matter-materialization/dissolve variants

families.name: Psychic abilities and equipment response
families.motion: Charge, shield/parry, grip/throw, cover generation/movement, gauntlet strike, orbit, pinball and unmake; code, emoji, battery and effects are separate layers

families.name: Combat reactions and resets
families.motion: Hit absorption, stagger, recovery, knockdown/death, finisher and respawn appropriate to each validated mechanic

directionPolicy: First validate the needed view/action in 08N. Then expand that family to the planned 24 nominal 15-degree views without mirror-swapping asymmetry. No completed 360 coverage asserted.
firstPlayableReplacement: HD01-HD04 at the supported corner, before the full library is finished; recovered art stays labeled elsewhere.
note: Targets and drawing requests are not completed exports. This queue is the pre-generation checkpoint. Update only with actual file and test evidence.
